notes.title: Halloween Update 1.08
notes.content:
Hello Spooky Teeth,

A new update with enhanced visuals and stuff!

[list]
[*] 4 new tooth troll monsters, FrankenTooth, Pumpkin, Dracula, and Witch
[*] special halloween level (can you find it?) with mini quest, music and spooky scenery
[*] 3 new pimp your tooth accessories
[*] New explosion visuals, boom!
[*] It's raining in Caries Town, moody
[*] The skip tutorial is no longer suitable for Youtubers who can't play the game... nyahaha! boom!
[*] ...but there are also secrets to be found there in the skip tutorial section...
[*] bug fixes and more
[/list]


Happy Halloween!

notes.title: Version 1.07 of Adventure in King Caries Land

notes.title: Full Soundtrack DLC and Version 1.06 of Adventure in King Caries Land!
notes.content:
Holy, Update-o Tooth-o-Rama, Batman!

Yes, High on the heels of V. 1.05 is a new update. Bug fixing and adding minor stuff.

Version 1.06 change log:

[list]

[*] Added a preloader node that should load the levels better

[*] Minor performance improvements

[*] Fixed floss whip connections to buildings on level 7 8 9

[*] Tweaked level 5's cowboy hat challenge (just run like hell and a  jelly may help)

[*] Music fades when exiting levels for a smoother experience.

[*] Removed the Debugger, should be smoother experience, keep me posted if you experience a bug on the discussion forum ːsteamhappyː
[/list]

Plus on a fun cool note, the full orchestral soundtrack DLC is now released. A powerful symphonic meets chip-tune bombastic extravaganza. Check it out now.
(The mp3's will be downloaded into your game directory)

Happy Toothing,
Max Robert
Solo Dev. Adventure in King Caries Land

notes.title: Version 1.05 of Adventure in King Caries Land
notes.content:
Hello all you wonderful Steam people, here is a new 1.05 update for the game.

[list]
[*] Added mouse gui elements, pointer and crosshair, hide that mouse pointer when in game etc.

[*] Start new game did not reset health in pimp your tooth menu fix

[*] Food timer should stop when beating King Caries(you shouldn't die... when you've made it so far...)

[*] Various Optimisations, refactoring code, crush detection, removed crush detection/particles that were taking performance,  range detection for processing enemies.

[*] Teleport to King Caries Lair should teleport accessories and toothpaste

[*] Small level tweaks

[/list]


Further stuff is in the works. The soundtrack DLC etc.

Have a nice week, take care and stay cool, all you tooth lovers out there.

Cheers!

Max Robert Arnborg,
Solo Developer of Adventure in King Caries Land
